page.layout: One page of text. At the top, a centred title line "PREFATIO." in spaced capitals, then a paragraph set in italic and roman that runs over five lines. Below it, a woodcut of a flower vase fills the middle of the page. Under the woodcut are faint, mostly illegible lines, probably show-through from the reverse, and at lower right a bold italic word "Nomina".

main_text.head: PREFATIO.
main_text.p: tionem desideret[?], adeat meam CLAVEM HE-BRAICAM VETERIS TEST. in qua suis locis omnes tales voces totius Veteris Test. He-braici clarè & dilucidè explicantur. Vale & laboribus meis fave-

page.notes: The woodcut of a flower vase in the middle of the page is an illustration and has no text. The faint marks and fragments of lines below it look like show-through from the reverse side and are left out. The first word of the paragraph is a fragment, "tionem", and "desideret" is partly overprinted, so it is marked [?]. "Nomina" is set apart in bold italic at lower right. I have included it as printed, but it may belong to a different layer of the scan. The paragraph breaks off at "fave-" and continues on a later page.
